claim_text: The Saudi crown prince rises and takes a part in Iraq and elsewhere in the Middle East once Iran is dealt with, oil and gas wealth flows to those countries, the beast system begins to rise, and a two-state solution starts to be talked about.
quote: I saw MBS rise up and start to have a part in Iraq
falsify_match: Saudi Arabia takes a leading role in Iraqi affairs and pushes a two-state framework.
falsify_miss: Saudi involvement in Iraq stays where it is and no two-state process opens.

claim_text: Talks open on Ukraine, Russia demands the whole country but holds the land it has conquered up to Kyiv, and a plan is devised to get rid of the Ukrainian president and install a proxy government.
quote: How do we eliminate Zelenskyy? To bring in a proxy government
falsify_match: Zelensky is removed and a pro-Russian government is installed in Kyiv.
falsify_miss: Zelensky remains in office and no proxy government is installed.

claim_text: Looking at Taiwan he can see lights and digital things but nothing further, because a barrier of prayer like gold lights surrounds the island.
quote: There was a barrier around Taiwan of prayer, and it was like lights of gold
falsify_match: Nothing observable. The barrier is a reason for not seeing rather than an event.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable, which is the point worth recording: it makes the absence of the Taiwan fall explicable.

claim_text: Cuba seen in time lapse growing, which looks like a blessing for the Cuban people.
quote: it looked like a blessing for the Cuban people
falsify_match: Measurable growth in Cuban living standards after a change of government.
falsify_miss: Cuban conditions stay as they are or worsen.

claim_text: A red wave tries to come over California, flipping the governorship and seats to Republicans, with Pelosi gone, driven by outrage as fraud is uncovered.
quote: Flipping the governor to a Republican. Flipping seats into Republican
falsify_match: California elects a Republican governor and flips congressional seats.
falsify_miss: California stays Democratic at the 2026 governorship and in its delegation. He hedges with not all of it.

claim_text: He relays a first person account of a call from three named officials saying a deal was being broken, and an order given that took out the biggest bridge in Iran within ten minutes.
quote: within 45 minutes, I gave the order to knock out the biggest bridge
falsify_match: Not his claim. He is relaying the president speaking in the first person.
falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded so the quoted material is not mistaken for a word.

claim_text: After Iran is brought back to the stone age it retaliates through hidden cells inside America, with the power grids and substations named as what to pray over.
quote: They're going to retaliate with their hidden cells in your own nation
falsify_match: An attack on American electrical infrastructure attributed to Iranian-directed operatives.
falsify_miss: No such attack. The prayer condition gives an exit if none occurs.

claim_text: Some cities go without power for over a month, banking stops, certain banks close entirely and stock markets do not work, with emergency lights shone on buildings in downtown New York in hot weather.
quote: Some cities that would not have power for over a month
falsify_match: An American city loses power for more than a month with banks and markets closed.
falsify_miss: No outage of that length. The longest recent American outages outside hurricane-hit islands have run days, not weeks.

claim_text: Another BP-style oil spill comes forth in the Gulf, with the large platform rigs sabotaged, and a call to pray over the oil and gas plants at Tuttle, Houston and Louisiana.
quote: I saw BP oil spill again. Another kind of a BP oil spill
falsify_match: A major spill in the Gulf traced to deliberate sabotage of a platform.
falsify_miss: No large Gulf spill. Deepwater Horizon remains the only one at that scale in the region.

claim_text: Drones are used against baseball stadiums, with the New York Yankees named, landing an explosive device that is set off inside, and the marathons in Boston on the 20th are to be prayed over.
quote: using drones against baseball stadiums. New York Yankees
falsify_match: A drone-delivered explosive at an American stadium, or an attack on the Boston marathon.
falsify_miss: The 20 April marathon and the baseball season pass without a drone attack.

claim_text: A prayer over decisions to be made in the next couple of hours about which bridge and which electric plant in Iran to hit first, asking that the president be led by the spirit and play it as a chess game.
quote: which bridge to hit first, which electric plant to hit first
falsify_match: Strikes on Iranian bridges and power plants within hours of the broadcast.
falsify_miss: No such strikes. Framed as a petition, which softens what would count.

claim_text: The Iranian administration is sent completely back to the stone age, the people rise up and revolt against those in power, and a glorious revival follows throughout Iran, with the grey-headed bald prince seen again.
quote: the people of Iran will rise up and revolt against this evil tyrant government
falsify_match: A popular uprising removes the Iranian leadership and a mass religious movement follows.
falsify_miss: The government holds. Stone age has no threshold, but the uprising and the named prince do.

claim_text: He recalls seeing wells of oil coming up in Venezuela under drill baby drill.
quote: I saw wells of oil coming for I drill, baby, drill
falsify_match: A large expansion of Venezuelan production under American operators.
falsify_miss: Output stays flat. Drill baby drill was administration policy before this, which is the priority problem.

claim_text: There is one more major round over Iran, hitting strategic infrastructure of a major city rather than all of it.
quote: There's one more round. There's one more major
falsify_match: One further major strike round on Iranian city infrastructure, then a stop.
falsify_miss: Either no further round, or a long series rather than one.

claim_text: He states that plan A was the Supreme Court and it failed, that he then said to get ready for a war to bring forth the American economy, and that this has come to pass.
quote: plan A was the the Supreme Court and the Supreme Court failed us
falsify_match: The earlier recordings contain the war warning tied to the tariff ruling, before the event.
falsify_miss: The earlier recordings do not contain it, or contain it only after the ruling was public.

claim_text: Iran crippled back to the stone age, Venezuela, the Gulf and American oil brought together to restore the petrodollar, with American stakes in Iraq from the first Iraq war and Iraqi wells pumping.
quote: A bringing forth a petrodollar. Watch Iraq
falsify_match: Oil pricing shifts measurably back toward dollar settlement on the back of these sources.
falsify_miss: The dollar share of oil settlement keeps falling, or Iraqi output does not rise.

claim_text: He recalls saying that Turkey would take over the strait into the Black Sea, putting on a vampire cape, with war drums, and places Carney alongside Europe, England, the royals, Germany, Macron and Italy.
quote: he puts on a vampire cape and starts to take over the straits
falsify_match: Turkey closes or controls the straits in a way that goes beyond the Montreux terms.
falsify_miss: Turkey applies Montreux as it already has since 2022, which would not be new.

claim_text: China cracks the whip toward North Korea and uses its leader as a pawn, promising him a seat at the table with Russia and BRICS.
quote: China will use Kim Jong Un as a pawn promising him a seat
falsify_match: North Korea is brought into a BRICS or Russia-China forum at China's invitation.
falsify_miss: No such inclusion. North Korea has never been a BRICS candidate.

claim_text: Deals over minerals and heavy metals, with cobalt named, come out of the decisions the president is making now and extend into Cuba.
quote: I still get about minerals and heavy metal mineral deals. And they would about cobalt
falsify_match: A named cobalt or heavy metals agreement signed in this period.
falsify_miss: No such deal. Cuba holds large nickel and cobalt reserves, which is where the association comes from.

claim_text: He recalls seeing up to twenty four billion dollars of Ukraine money held in secret accounts and funded back into the Democratic Party at election time.
quote: it was in secret accounts of up to 24 billion dollars
falsify_match: An audit finding American aid to Ukraine diverted into domestic political funding.
falsify_miss: No such finding. Inspector general reports on Ukraine aid have flagged accounting gaps, not party funding.

claim_text: He repeats the twenty four billion figure, says he saw the strategic accounts and that money will be called upon from them, and that it is election time again.
quote: I told you even the figure, I saw 24 billion dollars
falsify_match: Funds traced from those accounts into the 2026 midterm cycle.
falsify_miss: No trace. The figure repeats across tellings without a source being given.

claim_text: Leaders were set up and filmed, and the footage is used to blackmail them, which is darker than people realise, said most pointedly of the Ukrainian president.
quote: they use this stuff to blackmail them
falsify_match: Blackmail material on a head of state surfaces publicly.
falsify_miss: None surfaces. Nobody but Zelensky is named, so almost any scandal could be read into it.

claim_text: He is told to pray the president across the finish line concerning the midterms, and reports European leaders including Macron and France refusing to get involved over Iran or protect the strait.
quote: You must get him across the finish line concerning midterms
falsify_match: European governments publicly decline to join a strait protection effort.
falsify_miss: European navies join. He is quoting reported statements, so much of this is already public.

claim_text: Macron is the forerunner to the Antichrist and will come out as a tyrant in Europe, taking freedoms from the French and influencing England, Italy and Germany, with a Hitler type of anointing wrapping around him.
quote: I saw a Hitler type of a anointing trying to come on him
falsify_match: Macron takes emergency powers or curtails civil liberties in France.
falsify_miss: He leaves office at the 2027 term limit without doing so.

claim_text: Jared Kushner is one of the forerunners, bringing in peace agreements and getting things ready for the Antichrist to step on the scene.
quote: he will be the forerunner of helping out, too
falsify_match: Kushner brokers a further regional agreement.
falsify_miss: He brokers none. The Abraham Accords precedent makes the role a continuation rather than a new claim.

claim_text: He reports a text saying hundreds were healed and nine thousand born again in Cuba, with forty two thousand at the meeting and over nine hundred and seventy pastors.
quote: 9,000 people get born again in Cuba
falsify_match: Independent attendance or conversion figures near those numbers.
falsify_miss: No independent figures. These are reported to him by text and repeated without verification.

claim_text: A prayer noting the president had a rough day and using profanity, which they say they do not excuse, while crediting him with a great IQ.
quote: We don't excuse his behavior as the President of the United States
falsify_match: Nothing. A comment on a past day.
falsify_miss: Nothing forward-looking is claimed here.

claim_text: He thanks God that the tyrants who murdered Christians and mistreated women are no longer in power in Iran, and that the war will end with peace over the Middle East.
quote: those people are are no longer in power
falsify_match: The Iranian leadership is confirmed removed.
falsify_miss: The leadership remains. He speaks of it here as already accomplished, which is checkable against the record.

claim_text: America becomes financially stable through the oil he was shown under drill baby drill, and what was meant for bad is turned around for good.
quote: That the America will be financially stable
falsify_match: Measurable improvement in the federal fiscal position attributed to energy revenue.
falsify_miss: The deficit and debt keep rising. Financially stable is not defined.

claim_text: A tornado like a cartoon sweeps down a New York street around the president, blowing his hair and clothes, comes right up to his feet and stops.
quote: I see this tornado come right up to his feet and it stops
falsify_match: Nothing observable unless a literal tornado is meant.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. As an image of a threat that stops short it cannot fail.

claim_text: Maliki is seen alongside great oil derricks in Iraq like the old Texas ones, with oil springing out of the tops of them.
quote: I see Maliki. I see oil wells
falsify_match: A large rise in Iraqi output or new field development.
falsify_miss: Iraqi output stays near its current level. Iraq is already the second largest OPEC producer.

claim_text: As Iran crumbles and its infrastructure, finances, oil and the strait are crippled, the prince of Persia lets go of Iraq and a second plan comes across the land, which will be seen in the news.
quote: the prince of Persia lets go of Iraq
falsify_match: Iranian-aligned factions lose control of Iraqi institutions.
falsify_miss: They keep it. The prince of Persia framing means any partial change can be claimed.

claim_text: Great wealth comes out of Venezuelan oil and out of South America, with a shaking coming to Colombia where there is oil on the border.
quote: A shaking coming to Columbia. There's oil in Columbia
falsify_match: Political upheaval in Colombia alongside new border oil development.
falsify_miss: Colombia stays stable. Shaking is undefined and could be read onto any unrest or quake.

claim_text: Mineral deals over Greenland for heavy metals, with trucks working the soil there, seen alongside Saudi Arabia and Gaza.
quote: There's something with Greenland concerning mineral deals
falsify_match: A signed American mining agreement covering Greenland rare earths.
falsify_miss: No agreement. Greenland mineral access was already a public policy aim before this.

claim_text: The same passage on Greenland mineral deals and heavy metals, repeated in the overlapping segment window.
quote: I see trucks and I see them working this soil
falsify_match: Same as the preceding row.
falsify_miss: Same as the preceding row. Recorded because the picker treated the two windows separately.

claim_text: Deals are attempted but the land goes to Russia, which floods it so that it becomes part of Russia.
quote: I see deals trying to be made, but I see the land going to Russia
falsify_match: Occupied territory is formally absorbed into Russia as part of a settlement.
falsify_miss: The land is returned or its status stays unresolved. He does not say which land, coming straight after the Greenland passage.

claim_text: Cuba seen in time lapse as a party island and tourist destination, with new buildings all over, cruise ports, hotels along the ocean front, while Taiwan is left with tourists staying.
quote: I see Cuba look like a party place
falsify_match: Large scale hotel and cruise port construction in Cuba.
falsify_miss: No building boom. Cuba already had cruise calls until American sailings were barred in 2019.

claim_text: The building goes right across the side of Cuba facing America, with manufacturing industries, cruise ships, hotels and what look like casinos, and many will come.
quote: Like a tourist destination. But but money coming up, buildings
falsify_match: Casinos and manufacturing established on the north coast of Cuba.
falsify_miss: None built. Casinos have been banned in Cuba since 1959, which is what would have to reverse.

claim_text: Cruise ships, money boats and yachts with men smoking cigars, and Taiwan seen again glowing with a yellow light.
quote: I see Taiwan again and Taiwan is glowing with a yellow light
falsify_match: Nothing observable. The light is not tied to an outcome.
falsify_miss: Nothing observable. The same island carries a gold barrier and a two day fall across tellings.

claim_text: Everything in Iran is smoking with oil and buildings burning and complete desolation, while palm trees and beautiful structures come up out of Iraq and a new Babylon rises with Rolls-Royces and Ferraris.
quote: I see a new Babylon rising
falsify_match: A visible Iraqi construction and luxury boom while Iran is devastated.
falsify_miss: Neither happens. Complete desolation of Iran is far beyond the June 2025 strikes.

claim_text: Iraq becomes like Saudi Arabia, and the great corruption there is tamed back by fifty per cent because Iran's hand is out of the cookie jar.
quote: But it's tamed back by 50%. I see the number 50%
falsify_match: Iraq's corruption index score improves by roughly half.
falsify_miss: The score stays flat. Iraq has ranked near the bottom of those indices for twenty years.

claim_text: Iran influenced Iraq and its hand will be out of the cookie jar for a season, with blessing and oil flowing in Iraq and structures like Saudi Arabia, while the prince of Persia looks wounded but is scheming.
quote: the hand will no longer be in the cookie jar for a season
falsify_match: Iranian influence over Iraq visibly recedes.
falsify_miss: It does not. For a season means a later return would also count as a match.

claim_text: Saudi Arabia rising up with coins behind it and the crown prince there, and he holds back the detail until he has prayed over it more.
quote: I see uh coins behind Saudi Arabia
falsify_match: A Saudi sovereign move into digital currency.
falsify_miss: None. Gulf sovereign crypto interest was already reported before this.

claim_text: Great wealth that had been held back is suddenly released because it had not been time, Iran's hand is removed, buildings go up and the Saudi crown prince influences it.
quote: It was held back. Iran had their hand in the cookie jar
falsify_match: A sudden regional investment surge led from Riyadh.
falsify_miss: No surge. Suddenly carries no date, and hadn't been time explains any delay.

claim_text: The Saudi crown prince comes on the scene in Israel as a forerunner for a two-state solution, with Jared at the front in a black suit and tie with dark circles under his eyes.
quote: I see him being a forerunner for a two-state solution
falsify_match: Saudi Arabia publicly leads a two-state process with Kushner as intermediary.
falsify_miss: No process opens. Riyadh has conditioned normalisation on a Palestinian state since 2023, so the position predates this.
